mkdir -p tools/android && cat > tools/android/ensure-alpha-signing.sh <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SIGNING_DIR="${LCL_ANDROID_ALPHA_SIGNING_DIR:-$HOME/.config/local-climate-link/android}"
KEYSTORE="$SIGNING_DIR/alpha.keystore"
PROPERTIES="$SIGNING_DIR/alpha-signing.properties"
ALIAS="localclimatealpha"

mkdir -p "$SIGNING_DIR"
chmod 700 "$SIGNING_DIR"

if [[ -e "$KEYSTORE" || -e "$PROPERTIES" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -f "$KEYSTORE" || ! -f "$PROPERTIES" ]]; then
    echo "Alpha signing state is incomplete; refusing to overwrite existing material." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
else
  umask 077
  PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
  keytool -genkeypair \
    -keystore "$KEYSTORE" \
    -storepass "$PASSWORD" \
    -keypass "$PASSWORD" \
    -alias "$ALIAS" \
    -keyalg RSA \
    -keysize 3072 \
    -validity 10000 \
    -dname "CN=Local Climate Link Alpha, OU=Local Climate Link, O=Local Climate Link, L=Warsaw, ST=Mazowieckie, C=PL" \
    >/dev/null 2>&1
  cat > "$PROPERTIES" <<EOF
storeFile=$KEYSTORE
storePassword=$PASSWORD
keyAlias=$ALIAS
keyPassword=$PASSWORD
EOF
  chmod 600 "$KEYSTORE" "$PROPERTIES"
  unset PASSWORD
fi

chmod 600 "$KEYSTORE" "$PROPERTIES"
STORE_PASSWORD="$(sed -n 's/^storePassword=//p' "$PROPERTIES")"
KEY_ALIAS="$(sed -n 's/^keyAlias=//p' "$PROPERTIES")"
KEY_PASSWORD="$(sed -n 's/^keyPassword=//p' "$PROPERTIES")"
test -n "$STORE_PASSWORD"
test -n "$KEY_ALIAS"
test -n "$KEY_PASSWORD"
FINGERPRINT="$(keytool -list -v -keystore "$KEYSTORE" -storepass "$STORE_PASSWORD" -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" -keypass "$KEY_PASSWORD" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*SHA256: //p' | head -1 | tr -d ':' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
test -n "$FINGERPRINT"
printf 'alpha_signing=ready\nalpha_keystore=%s\nalpha_cert_sha256=%s\n' "$KEYSTORE" "$FINGERPRINT"
SH
chmod +x tools/android/ensure-alpha-signing.sh

cat > tools/android/phone-alpha-install.sh <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

APP_ID="link.localclimate.app"
SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}"
ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"
APKSIGNER="$SDK/build-tools/36.0.0/apksigner"
SIGNING_PROPERTIES="${LCL_ANDROID_ALPHA_SIGNING_DIR:-$HOME/.config/local-climate-link/android}/alpha-signing.properties"

"$ROOT/tools/android/ensure-alpha-signing.sh"
test -x "$ADB"
test -x "$APKSIGNER"

SERIALS="$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}')"
COUNT="$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
if [[ "$COUNT" != "1" ]]; then
  echo "Expected exactly one authorized Android device; found $COUNT." >&2
  "$ADB" devices -l >&2
  exit 1
fi
SERIAL="$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d')"

pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile build
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
( cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug )

APK="$ROOT/apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
test -f "$APK"

KEYSTORE="$(sed -n 's/^storeFile=//p' "$SIGNING_PROPERTIES")"
STORE_PASSWORD="$(sed -n 's/^storePassword=//p' "$SIGNING_PROPERTIES")"
KEY_ALIAS="$(sed -n 's/^keyAlias=//p' "$SIGNING_PROPERTIES")"
KEY_PASSWORD="$(sed -n 's/^keyPassword=//p' "$SIGNING_PROPERTIES")"
EXPECTED="$(keytool -list -v -keystore "$KEYSTORE" -storepass "$STORE_PASSWORD" -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" -keypass "$KEY_PASSWORD" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*SHA256: //p' | head -1 | tr -d ':' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
ACTUAL="$("$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
test -n "$EXPECTED"
test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"
printf 'apk_signer_sha256=%s\n' "$ACTUAL"

# Phone-alpha runs are intentionally clean installs: always attempt to remove the prior package first.
UNINSTALL_OUTPUT="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" uninstall "$APP_ID" 2>&1)" || {
  if "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$APP_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf '%s\n' "$UNINSTALL_OUTPUT" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}
printf '%s\n' "$UNINSTALL_OUTPUT"

"$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" install "$APK"
"$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$APP_ID"
"$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$APP_ID/.MainActivity"
printf 'phone_alpha_device=%s\n' "$SERIAL"
SH
chmod +x tools/android/phone-alpha-install.sh

## Physical Android phone alpha install policy

Phone-alpha builds use a project-specific local alpha signing key stored outside the repository at `~/.config/local-climate-link/android/`. Run `pnpm android:phone-alpha`; it creates the key once when missing, rebuilds the debug APK with that stable signer, verifies the APK signer, then performs a clean install.

Every phone-alpha install intentionally runs `adb uninstall link.localclimate.app` before installation. This resets app data and permissions by design and prevents stale or differently signed development packages from blocking the test. The keystore and its credentials must never be committed or printed to logs. Release/Play signing remains separate and continues to use the `LCL_ANDROID_*` release-signing environment variables.
'''
